local_validation.patch_reproduction: All sixteen patched engine files and candidate probe hashes match a fresh preparation byte for byte.
local_validation.binary_restoration: Rebuilt the final preparation after the negative control. target/debug/bulwark-experiment-e4 matches the SHA-256 of both passing final reports.

limitations: Multiprocess evidence uses unsandboxed children on macOS arm64 with software rendering.
The exit fixture covers one affected view and an independent surviving view. Shared-process views, forced termination, and normal teardown races need dedicated fixtures.
Backend disconnection, failures before document construction, and remaining replacement paths remain open.
The host allocation counter is not a production registry or handle revocation mechanism.
Upstream review must settle cancellation, interruption, lifeline recovery, and callback/delegate unwind policy before integration.
Earlier effects, promise reactions, and timers survive interruption. Product policy remains undecided.
No new Linux, native-input, release-performance, or remote CI evidence is claimed.
